name: side-sessions-marketplace

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: Side Sessions 多会话树插件市场

description: Claude Desktop-style multi-session tree, isolated Git worktree parallel subtasks, lossless merge-tree integration, native session guard coexistence, and zero-ASAR-patch L1 persistent sidebar tree UI for ZCode (verified on ZCode 3.17.2 - 3.18.2).

description_i18n.en: Claude Desktop-style multi-session tree, isolated Git worktree parallel subtasks, lossless merge-tree integration, native session guard coexistence, and zero-ASAR-patch L1 persistent sidebar tree UI for ZCode (verified on ZCode 3.17.2 - 3.18.2).
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 ZCode（已适配验证 3.17.2 – 3.18.2）的 Claude Desktop 风格多会话树插件：支持每父会话 4 槽并发派发、只读沙箱与仓库外独立 Git Worktree 隔离、零污染 merge-tree 代码合并、原生 Session 工具防脑裂协同，以及免改包免重启 L1 主进程常驻左侧边栏可折叠会话树。
